decisions.reason: As a newly launched software product with its own page and strong fit to the firm's data-driven direction, management is likely to persist and give the investment more time.
Although public commitment is weaker than for A, it is close to the core offer and aligned with connected infrastructure management, so the firm would usually continue it rather than retreat quickly.
Its own page signals visible commitment and it builds on the established water-infrastructure offer, which makes management inclined to justify the launch and retain it.

This product is somewhat less central to the firm's digital strategic direction and was only mentioned on the website, but as a recent extension of the established portfolio it would still more likely be kept than dropped.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is close to the core business and supports the move toward more connected operations, so prior development effort and strategic fit favor continuation.
